FluoroMax Plus Benchtop Spectrofluorometer | Horiba
The FluoroMax® Plus represents HORIBA’s industry-leading fluorometer performance in a convenient, affordable, easy-to-use benchtop model. The FluoroMax family, with its unique all reflective optics and photon counting was the first to bring the sensitivity of a modular fluorometer to a tabletop fluorescence instrument, in the 1990’s. It’s a compact spectrofluorometer, yet offers the ultimate sensitivity in fluorescence investigations as well as features not found in most table-top fluorescence detection systems.

Description 
Features and Benefits:
Signal-to-Noise Ratio for Water Raman: 10,000:1 (FSD Method): Exceptional signal-to-noise ratio ensures precise and accurate measurements in Raman spectroscopy, particularly in the challenging detection of water Raman signals.
Photon Counting Detection for Ultimate Sensitivity: Utilizes photon counting for unparalleled sensitivity, enabling the detection of low-intensity signals with high precision.
Fast Scanning Capability: Up to 80 nm/second: High-speed scanning capability allows for rapid data acquisition, optimizing efficiency in experimental workflows.
Powerful FluorEssence™ Software for Windows®: Advanced software platform designed for comprehensive control, data analysis, and visualization, enhancing the overall user experience.
Method Files for Experiment Parameter Retrieval: Convenient method files facilitate the retrieval of experiment parameters, streamlining experimental setup and ensuring reproducibility.
Time-Correlated Single Photon Counting (TCSPC) Accessory for Lifetime Measurements: Integration of TCSPC accessory enables precise measurements of fluorescence lifetimes, expanding the range of experimental possibilities.
Phosphorimeter Accessory for Long-Lifetime Luminescence Determinations: Includes a phosphorimeter accessory designed for accurate determinations of long-lifetime luminescence phenomena.
Technical Specifications:
Lamp: 150 W Xenon arc lamp, vertically mounted, ozone-free.
Gratings: 1200 grooves/mm, ruled at 330 nm (excitation) and 500 nm (emission), plane ruled for automatic calibration of all wavelength units and slits.
Monochromators: Czerny-Turner spectrometers with fully reflective optics.
Detectors: Emission: R928P PMT for photon counting (185-850 nm) and reference photodiode for lamp emission monitoring.
Water Raman S/N: 10,000:1 (FSD method).
Slits: Continuously adjustable from 0 to 29 nm.
Accuracy: 0.5 nm.
Reproducibility: 0.1 nm.
Minimum Step: 0.0525 nm.
Integration Time: 0.001 to 160 seconds.
Software: FluorEssence.
Spectral Correction Factors: Included.
